limits: Counts cover generation and scored semantic review; case/archive authoring, preflight auditing, orchestration and final completion auditing are additional work outside these role counts.
Native events are parent-recorded observations, not platform attestation. Two joins recover valid saved outputs after verified native handle absence; they do not claim an observed terminal response.
Saved word counts include JSON representation. Missing output has unknown size; no complete run cost can be inferred from known persisted text.
Actual tokens, internal model calls, model seeds and hidden compute are unavailable. Soft allocations do not establish equal compute.
Observed spawn/join timestamps are orchestration observations, not precise model runtimes.
A valid JSON artifact or a completed assessment establishes neither empirical effectiveness nor worldwide originality.
